string.text: Long time no see, Commander. I am Koleda. Rejoice, because my arrival means that spring days will be coming soon.
Yo, finally awake? Want to join me in skipping out on work? No? Ehhhh~ You're way too serious, Commander.
Koleda, you seem to have changed during the past years...

If Ange taught me anything, it would be that one must always have cards to play at any time. You might say I've become more ruthless, but I will never, ever allow myself to feel that powerless again. It's... loathsome.
Okay Koleda, please head back to base. I will handle it from here.
*Ask how her body is holding up.*
You DO know I can clearly see the expression on your face and where you're looking, right?
